changelog.description: Countdown timer removed from CLI auth selection — the menu now waits as long as you need
Auth menu standardized: 1 = QR Code, 2 = Pairing Code (same menu in edbots start and edbots pair)
Pairing code flow no longer hangs after selecting option 2 (readline interface is now reusable)
Invalid phone numbers are re-asked with helpful examples instead of exiting the CLI
Piped or closed input can no longer hang the CLI — EOF falls back to QR mode safely
Shared auth selection module (authSelect.js) used by start, pair and flag-based flows
